name: Fixed15 ML continuation with evidenced OTC equity registration
confirmation_scope: Explicit research scenario: ordinary unrestricted domestic holder completes confirmation, custody and funding-account procedures by the published deadline. Not evidence that a real account completed them.
bridge: At delisting, convert old adjusted units into equal original raw shares in a non-tradable equity claim. At listing, reclassify claim one-for-one as 400236.OC. No cash, sale or fee on either classification.
unlisted_valuation: Carry last observable raw close0.18 as a separately flagged stale valuation, not fair value or a realizable cash amount. Never use future listing prices early.
execution: Original next-session-close instructions unchanged. No forced first-day sale; OTC successor is exit-only and sold by the next original non-HOLD target that permits execution. No quote/no volume/one-price limit-down blocks selling.
otc_limit_rule: 5% rounded half-up to0.01 yuan, with at least one tick move; first-day range0.17..0.19 comes from issuer notice. One-price limit-up does not block a sell.
unchanged: Reuse exact sealed13-factor model scores, weekly schedules, fixed15 selection, buffers, portfolio constraints and daily risk budgets. All12 accounts rerun including4 RankIC baselines for exact parity.
limitations: Single public vendor OTC daily transaction statistics; not independently verified trade tape.
Last-observable valuation during suspension/unlisted interval is uncertain, separately disclosed.
Fractional-share normalized accounts, no minimum commissions, lot-size, full tax, queue or participation-size simulation; auction close sale is conditional research execution, not guaranteed fill.
First-day eligibility depends on timely confirmation assumption. Delayed confirmation must be a separate evidence-backed scenario.
Retrospective data already studied; no untouched holdout and no automatic paper/live promotion.
Unknown additional terminated holdings still abort instead of being zeroed or carried indefinitely.
